analogy.rationale: TP53 inhibitors block p53 function, which in these cell lines produces little transcriptional change because p53 is largely inactive under unstressed conditions; MDM inhibitors act in the same p53 pathway and may show some overlap, while DNA-damaging or replication-stress classes act upstream of p53 and would only partially phenocopy loss of p53 function.
